dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, help example, and unchanged no-selection paths are present.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go flag additions and validateListOpts

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution uses canonical selected fields; unknown and ambiguous cases provide sorted actionable candidates.
evidence: product.diff: resolve_fields.go ambiguity ID sorting hunk

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Initial definitions are reused; additional field pages are fetched only when indicated, with errors returned before rendering.
evidence: tests.log: focused project query tests passed

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All required scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, normalized, and default to empty when absent or unknown.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers and values are appended in request order; lookup by field node ID preserves empty cells and alignment.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selection and pagination errors return before table construction; the implementation uses existing query types, pagination helper, and table printer.
evidence: product.diff: selectedFields error returns before printResults
